query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN chebi_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_chebi,
  SUM(CASE WHEN chemical_family IS NOT NULL AND chemical_family != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_family,
  SUM(CASE WHEN chebi_id IS NOT NULL AND (chemical_family IS NULL OR chemical_family = '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as chebi_no_family
FROM molecules;
